paragraphs: Rav Chinena bar Shelamya, Rav's student. Jerusalem Sanhedrin, chapter 1: Chananyah bar Shelamya in Rav's name; Sukkah, chapter 1, halakhah 6; Beitzah 1:6:2 [received chapter 1, halakhah 5], in Rav's name. Shabbat 43b, 123a; Niddah 65a. He asked Rav: Niddah, there. R. Chanina bar Shelamya said to Rav, “And what does the Master hold?”: there, 25a. Beitzah 31b, “in Rava's name,” is a scribal error and should read Rav, as later there, at 32b, and in the new Talmud editions. Bekhorot 24b; Chullin 9a. Pesachim 105a: Rav Chanina bar Shelamya, etc., with Rav Hamnuna the Elder attending them, and Rav Amram also mentioned; see there. Chullin 37b: R. Chanina bar Shelamya. Teacher of R. Chiyya bar Rav. Eruvin 98b, near the end: he taught Chiyya bar Rav before Rav. Jerusalem Eruvin, chapter 1: he would teach Chiyya bar Rav.
